messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final social plan for next Tue's product webinar? Need X + LinkedIn thread cadence, one hero image, and routing for inbound registrants. Who's owning what? :eyes:
Sam: I can own scheduling. I'll queue the X thread for 10:00am PT and the LinkedIn post at 11:00am PT unless folks want different timing. Buffer or HubSpot? :calendar:
Jun: Drafts are ready. Proposed X thread is 6 posts: intro, 3 benchmark bullets, quick CTA to register, and a follow-up reminder. Copy snippet below:
```
Tweet 1: We built an inference stack that halves 99p latency for chat — and keeps costs predictable. Join our webinar 3/7 to see the numbers. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar-march-7
Tweet 2: Benchmark: 2x throughput at the same cost vs our previous baseline. Demo + Q&A — sign up.
```
Jun: Ping — please tighten the benchmark wording if legal/ops has concerns.
Olivia: For inbound routing — please tag registrants with "webinar_mar" and source param ?src=x_social or ?src=li_thread. SDR queue A should get first-touch leads. I'll update the playbook doc. :pushpin:
Hannah: I'll wire the Zap -> SFDC flow and make sure UTM params are captured. Need the final reg link + utm values. ops-bot: Registration page created: https://redwood.ai/webinar-march-7 (draft). Add utm_campaign=launch_social_v2 and utm_source as agreed.
Maya: Final reg link is live. Use utm_campaign=launch_social_v2. Sam — please add a 24h reminder tweet and LI reminder post. Jun — can you compress benchmark bullets to one punchy stat + a short 2-line explanation?
Sam: Yep. Scheduling Buffer -> done locally but will handoff to HubSpot if we decide to run paid boost. I left the X thread as a draft for review.
Jun: Updated copy. New copy for benchmark line: "2x throughput at parity cost — real-world nets from customer beta." Shortened CTA. Posting draft below.
Maya: Love it. Quick compliance check — don't use customer names; call it "beta participants." Legal ok? Hannah: good catch, legal asked for that phrasing.
Olivia: Also capture "interest_reason" field on registration form so SDRs know whether it's latency, cost, or reliability. That will help follow-ups.
Maya: Great. Action list: Sam = schedule & publish, Jun = finalize copy + hero image alt text, Hannah = SFDC mapping + UTM, Olivia = SDR routing config. I'll compile and drop the final assets in the #content-assets folder by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam: noted. I'll ping here once publish is queued.
Jun: uploading hero image to Figma now and adding alt text.
Maya: Thanks team — tiny follow-up: please add the short 1-sentence webinar blurb for the LinkedIn post (makes the LI algorithm happy).
